short_title: Why Do Sea Turtles Cry? It's Not Sadness 😱
title_options: Why Do Sea Turtles Cry? It's Not Sadness 😱
Why Is This Sea Turtle Crying? 1, 2 or 3? 🐢
Sea Turtles Cry Salt: Up to 2 Gallons an Hour 🐢
seo_intro:
Why do sea turtles cry? Is it sadness, pain, or too much salt?
Sea turtles cry to get rid of excess salt: their kidneys can't remove it all, so salt glands next to their eyes push it out in tears almost twice as salty as seawater.

tiktok_text:
Why do sea turtles cry? 🐢 It's not sadness and it's not pain. Turtles take in a lot of salt (a leatherback's jellyfish meals are mostly salty seawater), and their kidneys can't get rid of it all. So glands next to their eyes pump it out, in tears almost twice as salty as the ocean. Scientists estimate a feeding leatherback can cry about two gallons an hour. Not sadness. Survival.
